reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is to provide memory/context enhancement in chat composition by letting users insert workspace file and cross-session references via `@`, with pre-send validation and context injection; evidence for this is directly stated in the README and reinforced by declared web client/runtime wiring and workspace/session service dependencies.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 网页编辑器的上下文增强插件，支持通过 @ 快速引用工作区文件或同工作区会话，并在发送前校验引用有效性。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web composer plugin that enables @ mentions for workspace files and workspace sessions, with validation of references before message send.

capabilities: Supports `@`-based file mentions in DeepSeek Harness web composer using workspace file lookup
Supports `@`-based references to other sessions in the same workspace
Validates referenced files/sessions before message send and blocks stale references
Injects bounded session snapshots or exposes session-reading context for model input

reasons.code: README states the plugin provides file and session `@` context references for the DeepSeek Harness web composer.
Package metadata declares web client runtime and input-trigger injection, indicating UI/UX entrypoint in composer.
Peer dependencies include workspace file system, session, and session-reference/search services, implying access to local project/session context data.
